scope: Cooperative workspace isolation for collect/import/status/finalize, including collect CLI preflight
behavior: Persistent sibling lock inode, nonblocking OS exclusive lock; busy returns workspace_busy before reading workspace; release on normal exit, exception or process death. Nested calls use locked helpers.

validation.red_regression: Isolated copy without decorators allowed competing real finalize CLI to exit 0; expected workspace_busy exit 4.
validation.real_cli_interleaving: Finalizer paused immediately before receipt publication; collect/import/status/finalize competitors return workspace_busy, workspace bytes unchanged; released finalizer succeeds and repeat finalize preserves bytes.
validation.recovery: Exception and killed lock-holder process release OS lock; subsequent status succeeds. This is lock release only, not transaction recovery.
validation.boundaries: Symlink/hardlink lock paths and absent platform locking rejected; protected files unchanged. Disabled-provider collect returns busy while held, provider_disabled after release.

limits: Lifecycle remains PARTIAL: init competition, multi-file interrupted publication and recovery remain OPEN.
External writers and lock-file deletion/replacement bypass cooperative protocol.
Windows msvcrt, network filesystems and power-loss durability UNVERIFIED.
Lock sidecar persists outside sealed workspace; parent must permit initial lock creation.
No live provider, app, commit, push or release.
